# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_SQUEEZE_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon contracts (low width) indicating volatility compression, a breakout above the squeeze high often precedes an impulsive move. This setup aims to capture the explosive leg that follows a volatility squeeze by entering on the first bar that closes above the prior bar's high with elevated volume, after two consecutive bars of ribbon width below a threshold.

## Mechanism

Compute ribbon width as (EMA8 - EMA21) / ATR(14). If width < 0.2 for two consecutive bars, then on the next bar, if close > high of the prior bar and volume > 1.5x the 20-bar average volume, enter long at next bar open. Exit: stop at low of the squeeze bar (the bar where the second narrow ribbon occurred); TP1 at 2R (distance entry to stop); runner using chandelier trail (ATR*3) trailing stop. Regime filters: only trade when VIX < 18 and time between 09:45-11:30 ET to avoid afternoon chop.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** The proposed qty=28 contracts assumes a $25K+ account to fit the 50% per-trade risk cap; a $1K paper account would realize approximately 14% of the headline P&L (same scaling as OP-20 disclosure).
2. **Sample bias:** No historical sample has been evaluated; the proposal is based on a conceptual edge derived from volatility breakout theory. Sample size = 0, selection method = none, overfit risk = high until a Stage-1 backtest is performed.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward held-out window tested).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no realistic OPRA fill simulation on top 3 J days).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: false breakout in choppy market leading to repeated stop-outs; max drawdown scenario: series of losing squeezes during low-VIX, sideways periods; blow-up scenario: volatility expansion after entry causing adverse move beyond stop due to slippage on 0DTE options.
6. **Concentration:** Unknown until Stage-1 backtest; cannot estimate what percentage of P&L comes from top-5 days.
